node.title: XR one-defect low-core lies outside the ambient augmented-paving payment
node.statement: The generic XR rank-five (u,v)=(1,0) kernel is a four-dimensional quartic subspace and need not be MDS: span(1,X,X^2,L_T) is source-compatible but has a dependent evaluation four-set T. Hence the printed all-pair weighted-RS paving theorem does not apply to this whole branch. Even granting its strongest ambient deep-hole specialization on the special MDS branch gives RowC ceilings 9,009,204,611 / 19,418,424,240 / 123,242,307,467, all above 8*1024^3. At rate quarter a closing augmented-basis proof must establish beta_5(A)<=2,164,663,517,435, a source-coupled saving of at least 105,656,044,614 five-row bases (4.653796 percent) from ambient. This is a sharp route fence, not an XR payment.
